flags: Youdao and NetEase Group have both approved extending the maturity of the NetEase revolving loan Facility, including loans already drawn under it, to March 31, 2030.
The Group repaid US$15.0 million under the NetEase Facility up to March 31, 2026.
Youdao ceased its Academic AST Business to comply with PRC regulatory requirements; that business accounted for approximately 25.0% of 2021 net revenues.

business_model.basis: stated in P3; segment rows also appear in F2
business_model.claim: Youdao reports three segments: learning services, smart devices and online marketing services.
quotes: We have three reportable segments: (i) learning services, (ii) smart devices, and (iii) online marketing services.

business_model.basis: stated in the P3 net revenue table
business_model.claim: In 2025, learning services were 2,630,571 (RMB table in thousands, 44.5 share of total), smart devices 739,644 (12.5) and online marketing services 2,538,804 (43.0), out of total net revenues of 5,909,019.

Most learning services revenue comes from tutoring services, meaning digital learning contents and online courses. Tutoring revenue fell from RMB2,914.1 million to RMB2,384.7 million to RMB2,086.3 million across 2023-2025. Its share of total revenue fell from 54.1% to 42.4% to 35.3%.
quotes: We generate the majority of the net revenues of learning services from our tutoring services.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 as an expectation
business_model.claim: The company says it has expanded digital content services while adjusting STEAM and adult courses, and it expects digital content's revenue contribution to rise.
quotes: As a result, we expect the revenue contribution from our digital content services to increase time over time.

business_model.basis: stated in P3; balances in F1
business_model.claim: Tutoring is collected in advance and recorded as deferred revenue. Online courses are recognised over a weighted average learning period of five months. Tutoring deferred revenue was RMB638.3 million at end-2024 and RMB593.0 million at end-2025.
quotes: The estimated weighted average duration of learning periods of our online courses was five months for the periods presented in this annual report.

business_model.claim: Other learning services are fee-based premium services. These are subscription packages sold to individual users, such as Youdao Dictionary, and technology licensing to business customers, including through Youdao Smart Cloud.
quotes: These services mainly include: (a) sales of subscription packages to users of our AI-driven subscription services, such as Youdao Dictionary, that allow them to access additional functions, content and privileges and (b) the licensing of technologies and solutions, including through Youdao Smart Cloud, to business customers.

business_model.claim: Smart devices, mainly dictionary pens and tutoring pens, are sold through retailers or distributors. Segment revenue fell from RMB903.7 million to RMB739.6 million between 2024 and 2025, and its share of total revenue fell from 16.1% to 12.5%.
quotes: We sell smart devices such as Youdao Dictionary Pen and Youdao Tutoring Pen to customers through retailers or distributors.

business_model.claim: Online marketing services are mainly performance-based advertising charged per click, plus global marketing and promotion services charged as fixed fees. These advertising services made up 94.9% of segment revenue in 2025.
quotes: We primarily offer performance-based advertising solutions which mainly charged on a per-click basis, as well as global marketing and promotion services, which typically charged as fixed advertising fees.

business_model.claim: Online marketing revenue grew from RMB1,331.9 million to RMB1,975.0 million to RMB2,538.8 million across 2023-2025. The company attributes the 2025 increase to demand from the NetEase group and overseas markets.
quotes: The year over year increase in 2025 was driven by the increased demand for the NetEase group and overseas markets, which was further driven by our continued investments in AI technology.

business_model.basis: stated in F2 and F1; the link to online marketing is inferred from P3
business_model.claim: Revenue from related parties rose to RMB920,917 in 2025 from RMB182,586 in 2024 (statement in thousands). Amounts due from NetEase Group rose to 321,359 from 79,700 (table in thousands).
quotes: include transactions with related parties of RMB67,844, RMB182,586 and RMB920,917 for the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively

business_model.claim: Online marketing results depend on advertisers and their budgets.
quotes: In addition, as we generate a significant portion of our net revenues from online marketing services, our results of operations are also affected by the general factors affecting our advertisers and their advertising budgets.

business_model.claim: The main cost of online marketing is traffic acquisition, meaning payments to third parties that place advertisers' ads. The segment's gross margin fell from 36.0% in 2024 to 27.1% in 2025.
quotes: Our cost of revenues of online marketing services consists primarily of (i) traffic acquisition costs, which consist primarily of payments to third parties that distribute our advertisers’ advertisements through such third parties’ internet properties; and (ii) payroll-related expenses, which consist primarily of the salaries and other benefits paid to our operation personnel that support our online marketing services.

business_model.claim: Learning services costs are mainly teaching staff and instructor revenue sharing, payment channel fees, course materials and technical support. The segment's gross margin was 60.2% in 2025.
quotes: Our cost of revenues of learning services consists primarily of (i) costs associated with our full-time teaching staff and service operations personnel, mainly including the salaries and other benefits paid to our instructors and teaching assistants and the fees paid to certain of our instructors pursuant to revenue sharing arrangements; (ii) payment channel fees charged by third-party online payment providers; (iii) costs of course materials, such as textbooks and exercise books, that we distribute to students of our tutoring services; and (iv) technical support costs.

business_model.claim: Smart device costs are mainly product costs and operations staff. The segment's gross margin rose from 38.7% in 2024 to 46.4% in 2025.
quotes: Our cost of revenues of smart devices consists primarily of (i) costs relating to the sales of our smart devices and (ii) costs associated with our operation staff related to smart devices.

business_model.basis: figures stated in P3; the mix explanation is inferred from them
business_model.claim: Overall gross margin fell from 51.4% to 48.9% to 44.3% across 2023-2025. Over the same period, the lowest-margin segment, online marketing, rose from 24.7% to 43.0% of revenue.
Sales and marketing is the largest operating expense, at 1,684,323 (RMB table in thousands, 28.6 of net revenues) in 2025. It includes spending on online traffic acquisition channels.
quotes: Our sales and marketing expenses consist primarily of (i) expenses relating to our marketing and branding activities, including expenses relating to our online traffic acquisition channels; (ii) payroll-related expenses, which consist primarily of the salaries and other benefits paid to our sales and marketing personnel; and (iii) the amounts we pay to third-party service providers to whom we outsource certain of our sales and marketing functions.

business_model.claim: Research and development is mainly payroll and fell from 743,364 to 514,232 (RMB table in thousands) between 2023 and 2025. In 2025 the company embedded its Confucius LLM across all three segments.
quotes: In 2025, we advanced our AI-native strategy by expanding our Confucius LLM portfolio and embedding it across our learning services, online marketing services and smart devices, launching new AI offerings such as Scholar AI, the AI Ad Placement Optimizer and Youdao iMagicBox, and expanding our smart device portfolio with the launch of brand-new tutoring pens Youdao SpaceOne and Youdao Space X.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 and F2; the offset is inferred from the stated figures
business_model.claim: Total operating expenses fell from 3,233,788 to 2,395,519 (RMB table in thousands) between 2023 and 2025. Operating results moved from (466,326) to 221,309 (statement in thousands).

business_model.basis: stated in F1, F2 and P4
business_model.claim: Loans from NetEase are a financing cost. Short-term loans were 878,000 and long-term loans 926,588 at end-2025, and interest expense was (62,972) in 2025 (tables in thousands).
quotes: The Group has been continuously receiving financial support from NetEase Group and according to the support letter issued by NetEase Group in May 2024, NetEase Group intends to provide financial support to the Group in the period no less than twelve months from the date of issuance of these financial statements.

business_model.claim: The company disposed of its Academic AST (after-school tutoring) business in 2021 to comply with PRC rules; that business had been about 25.0% of 2021 net revenues.
quotes: In 2021, the net revenues from our Academic AST Business accounted for approximately 25.0% of our net revenues.

business_model.basis: stated in the P5 unaudited release
business_model.claim: In the second quarter of 2026, learning services revenue rose and smart devices and online marketing revenue fell. Gross margin was 48.9%, against 43.0% a year earlier.
quotes: Net revenues from learning services were RMB795.6 million (US$117.3 million), representing a 20.9% increase from the same period in 2025.
Net revenues from smart devices were RMB86.8 million (US$12.8 million), representing a 31.5% decrease from the same period in 2025.
Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB584.4 million (US$86.1 million), representing a 7.7% decrease from the same period in 2025.
Gross margin was 48.9%, compared with 43.0% for the same period in 2025.

an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising
